reference_control.reason: CSS Shapes 1 sections 2 and 6.3 require distance-expanded contours to exclude the full line band. Chromium ExcludedSegment clamps the line block-size to the unexpanded reference box (10px here), under-querying a 20px line. The margin-box inset has the identical physical rectangle and shape-margin, with a containing reference box large enough for the full line query.
